full_judgment: 3. The present-opposite party as plaintiff filed the aforesaid suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in the suit properties measuring an area of 7 decimals of land. The case as has been set-out in this revisional application in short is that, that the suit properties of the disputed khatian originally belonged to one, Ram Mohini Dashi and others and at the request of the Muslim Community of Biddadhorpur village to the said Jomindar to donate 7 decimals of land for erecting a mosque, he then gave 7 decimals of land for use as mosque. But without erecting any mosque, the local people took a decision that the mosque will be created not in the suit property but at the adjacent land. However, in the S.A record, the suit land was wrongly prepared in the name of the father of the defendant, Yead Ali in collusion with the survey official, but in the possession column, the said land was mentioned as mosque and ditch possessed by the local Muslim people subsequently, for the permanent earning source to maintain the said mosque, it was decided by the member of mosque committee to build some shop over the said 7 decimals of land. There had been a youth club adjacent west to the suit plot being No. 4026 for an area of 4 decimals of land and upon adding that 4 decimals of land with 7 decimals of land the local people used to enjoy title and possession over the same. While R.S. record was going on, the local people then made a query at the survey office when they came to learn that R.S khatian was prepared in the name of the defendant in R.S plot No. 496 appertaining to R.S khatian No. 105. It has further been stated that, the defendant had no title and possession over the suit property rather the local people have been enjoying the same for long 62-65 years. However, the S.A and R.S record was wrongly prepared in the name of the defendant and hence the plaintiff filed the suit.
